name: Peninsula Gardens Live Rosin | Black Maple
description: Heavy sherb vibes. She smokes very sweet with excellent terpene transfer into the smoke. A potent tester that will hit you hard. She also washes extremely well so be ready to see her in rosin form coming out of our new lab.
